note: National name register. "name" is the plate name (at most 12 characters and 2 words); "officialName" the full name, printed small and decoding as an alias. Blocks are whole units of a name's range holding twice the area's compounds at first issue; the spare units of each name are kept for its future areas. Frozen at first issue: blocks never move, shrink or get renumbered; new areas and full blocks take the spare (sl_address.add_block).

rule.order: seed along the national Hilbert curve (order 16)
